title: Food Contact Materials — Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004
summary: Food-contact materials placed on the EU market must meet the general safety framework. The exact requirements depend on the material and intended use.
evidence: Supplier Declaration of Compliance/supporting documentation where applicable

title: Plastic Food-Contact Materials — Regulation (EU) No 10/2011
summary: Specific EU requirements apply to plastic materials and articles intended for food contact, including rules concerning authorised substances and migration.

title: Good Manufacturing Practice — Regulation (EC) No 2023/2006
summary: GMP rules apply to materials and articles intended to come into contact with food and cover manufacturing, processing and distribution stages.

title: Packaging and Packaging Waste — Regulation (EU) 2025/40 (PPWR)
summary: The PPWR establishes EU-wide packaging and packaging-waste requirements. Applicability and timing depend on the packaging, actor and specific obligation.

title: Germany — LUCID Packaging Register
summary: If the German market activity falls within the producer obligations, registration in the LUCID Packaging Register and related EPR duties may apply. The exact producer role and packaging classification must be checked.

title: Germany — System participation / packaging EPR
summary: Packaging subject to system participation can require participation in a compliance system and reporting of packaging quantities. Classification depends on the packaging and distribution model.

source.name: ZSVR — System participation and data reporting

title: Germany — Foreign producer / authorised representative check
summary: A company established abroad that sells packaged products directly to end users in Germany without a German branch may need an authorised representative for relevant EPR obligations.
